sub_parameters.name: host
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the node.

sub_parameters.name: port
sub_parameters.description: The access port number of the node.

sub_parameters.name: zoneId
sub_parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the zone ID for Shanghai Zone C is cn-shanghai-c.

parameters.name: nodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node

> COORDINATING (client node) and KIBANA (Kibana node) are not supported.
